Header.Name: Communication_Transcript
Header.Description: Transcript. The component describes a transcript of a communication with detailed information on access, transcription/annotation format(s), and technical metadata.

Element.name: Name
Element.Documentation: The name/label of the transcript.

Element.name: Format
Element.Documentation: The format of the described transcipt, specified as mimetype.

Element.name: Name
Element.Documentation: The name of the transcription.

Element.name: TranscriptionConvention
Element.Documentation: The transcription convention used.

Element.name: AlignmentStatus
Element.Documentation: Specifies if/how the transcript has been aligned with the audio.

Element.name: TranscriptionStatus
Element.Documentation: Specifies how much of the recording has been transcribed.

Element.name: Derivation
Element.Documentation: Indication of the type of derivation.

Element.name: DerivationMode
Element.Documentation: Indicates whether the derivation was created manually or automatically.

Element.name: Anonymized
Element.Documentation: Indicates whether or not the name and full name of the person participating in the session, experiment or similar resource creation process are replaced by pseudo names to make him/her anonymous.

Element.name: surname
Element.Documentation: The surname (family name) of a person related to the resource

Element.name: givenName
Element.Documentation: The given name (first name) of a person related to the resource; initials can also be used

Element.name: sex
Element.Documentation: The sex of a person related to or participating in the resource

Element.name: position
Element.Documentation: The position or the title of a person if affiliated to an organization

Element.name: email
Element.Documentation: The email address of a person or an organization

Element.name: url
Element.Documentation: A URL used as homepage of an entity (e.g. of a person, organization, resource etc.) and/or where an entity (e.g. LR, document etc.) is located

Element.Documentation: The street and the number of the postal address of a person or organization

Element.name: zipCode
Element.Documentation: The zip code of the postal address of a person or organization

Element.name: city
Element.Documentation: The name of the city, town or village as mentioned in the postal address of a person or organization

Element.name: region
Element.Documentation: The name of the region, county or department as mentioned in the postal address of a person or organization

Element.name: country
Element.Documentation: The name of the country mentioned in the postal address of a person or organization as defined in the list of values of ISO 3166

Element.name: telephoneNumber
Element.Documentation: The telephone number of a person or an organization; recommended format: +_international code_city code_number

Element.name: faxNumber
Element.Documentation: The fax number of a person or an organization; recommended format: +_international code_city code_number

Element.name: annotationType
Element.Documentation: Specifies the annotation level of the resource or the annotation type a tool/ service requires or produces as an output

Element.name: annotatedElements
Element.Documentation: Specifies the elements annotated at each annotation level

Element.name: annotationStandoff
Element.Documentation: Indicates whether the annotation is created inline or in a stand-off fashion

Element.name: segmentationLevel
Element.Documentation: Specifies the segmentation unit in terms of which the resource has been segmented or the level of segmentation a tool/service requires/outputs

Element.name: annotationFormat
Element.Documentation: Specifies the format that is used in the annotation process since often the mime type will not be sufficient for machine processing

Element.name: tagset
Element.Documentation: A name or a URL intended as reference for the tagset used in the annotation of the resource or by the tool/service

Element.name: tagsetLanguageId
Element.Documentation: The identifier of the tagset language; an autocompletion mechanism with values from the ISO 639 is provided in the editor, but the values can be subsequently edited for further specification (according to the IETF BCP47 guidelines)

Element.name: tagsetLanguageName
Element.Documentation: The name of the tagset language; an autocompletion mechanism with values from the ISO 639 is provided in the editor, but the values can be subsequently edited for further specification (according to the IETF BCP47 guidelines)

Element.name: conformanceToStandardsBestPractices
Element.Documentation: Specifies the standards or the best practices to which the tagset used for the annotation conforms

Element.name: theoreticModel
Element.Documentation: Name of the theoretic model applied for the creation or enrichment of the resource, and/or reference (URL or bibliographic reference) to informative material about the theoretic model used

Element.name: annotationMode
Element.Documentation: Indicates whether the resource is annotated manually or by automatic processes

Element.name: annotationModeDetails
Element.Documentation: Provides further information on annotation process

Element.name: annotationStartDate
Element.Documentation: The date in which the annotation process has started

Element.name: annotationEndDate
Element.Documentation: The date in which the annotation process has ended

Element.name: interannotatorAgreement
Element.Documentation: Provides information on the interannotator agreement and the methods/metrics applied

Element.name: intraannotatorAgreement
Element.Documentation: Provides information on the intra-annotator agreement and the methods/metrics applied

Element.name: role
Element.Documentation: role of documents (e.g. annotation reports, validation manuals, general documentation of the resource etc.)

Element.name: documentUnstructured
Element.Documentation: Used either as a free text description or as an unstructured (free form) presentation of a bibliographic record; alternative to the structured presentation of a document (cf. documentInfo)

Element.name: role
Element.Documentation: role of documents (e.g. annotation reports, validation manuals, general documentation of the resource etc.)

Element.name: documentType
Element.Documentation: Specifies the type of the document provided with or related to the resource

item.AppInfo: An article from a journal or magazine
A book with an explicit publisher
A work that is printed and bound, but without a named publisher or sponsoring institution
A report published by a school or other institution
A part of a book, which may be a chapter (or section) and/or a range of pages
A part of a book having its own title
An article in a conference proceedings
A document having an author and title, but not formally published
Use this type when nothing else fits

Element.name: title
Element.Documentation: The title of the document; the element can be repeated for the different language versions using the "lang" attribute to specify the language.

Element.name: author
Element.Documentation: The name(s) of the author(s); for multiple authors, please use "and" in between.

Element.name: editor
Element.Documentation: The name(s) of the editor(s); in case of multiple editors, please use "and" in between

Element.name: year
Element.Documentation: The year of publication or, for an unpublished work, the year it was written

Element.name: publisher
Element.Documentation: The name of the publisher/publishing house

Element.name: bookTitle
Element.Documentation: The title of a book, part of which is being cited

Element.name: journal
Element.Documentation: A journal name; abbreviations could also be provided

Element.name: volume
Element.Documentation: Specifies the volume of a journal or multivolume book

Element.name: series
Element.Documentation: The name of a series or set of books; when citing an entire book, the title field gives its title and an optional series field gives the name of a series or multi-volume set in which the book is published

Element.name: pages
Element.Documentation: One or more page numbers or range of page numbers

Element.name: edition
Element.Documentation: The edition of a book

Element.name: conference
Element.Documentation: The name of the conference in which the document has been presented

Element.name: doi
Element.Documentation: A digital object identifier assigned to the document

Element.name: url
Element.Documentation: A URL used as homepage of an entity (e.g. of a person, organization, resource etc.) and/or where an entity (e.g. LR, document etc.) is located

Element.name: ISSN
Element.Documentation: The International Standard Serial Number used to identify a journal

Element.name: ISBN
Element.Documentation: The International Standard Book Number

Element.name: keywords
Element.Documentation: The keyword(s) for indexing and classification of the document

Element.name: documentLanguageName
Element.Documentation: The name of the language the document is written in, as mentioned in IETF BCP47; an autocompletion mechanism with values from the ISO 639 is provided in the editor, but the values can be subsequently edited for further specification (according to the IETF BCP47 guidelines)

Element.name: documentLanguageId
Element.Documentation: The id of the language the document is written in; an autocompletion mechanism with values from the ISO 639 is provided in the editor, but the values can be subsequently edited for further specification (according to the IETF BCP47 guidelines)
